title: Flaky on Test Core (6/6): `packages/runtime` `share-links-refusal-order.test.ts` › dispatcher twin › "[#23372] email audience: the refusal is the one an unknown token and a password-less email link answer" times out at vitest's 5000 ms default
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named locus and a reproduction.** A required context (`Test Core`) went red on a test whose budget is the vitest default, while one test body runs a loop of 18 sequential resolve calls. Reader: the seat that triage routes `packages/runtime` to (`domain:cli` in the pm-dispatch domain table). The fix is local to one test file. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549), session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`, which met it on PR #24628. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The failure

`packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links-refusal-order.test.ts:356`, in `[#23328] share-link resolve refusal order — the dispatcher twin`, the case `[#23372] email audience: the refusal is the one an unknown token and a password-less email link answer`:

```text
Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
```

It is a timeout, not an assertion.

| run | head | event | this case | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| CI `39298888283`, job `118219765573` (`Test Core (6/6)`) | `e058ce508e` (PR #24628) | pull_request | > 5000 ms | **failure**: `Tests 1 failed \| 6654 passed \| 19 skipped (6674)`, `Test Files 1 failed \| 422 passed (423)` |
| CI `39294041418` | `65a8eeb7d4` (`main`, the PR's base) | push | — | success |
| CI `39298092429` | `973917c579` (`main`) | push | — | success |

- **Unrelated diff.** PR #24628 adds `export` to one `@objectstack/spec` function (`navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource`) plus its pin, docs and generated rows. Nothing on the share-link resolve path calls it.
- **Contended shard.** The red shard's vitest summary read `Duration 1081.32s (transform 144.78s, … import 2733.96s, tests 328.30s)`.

## Why the budget does not fit

The case makes its calls one after another in a single `it`:
- 1 call for the unknown-token reference;
- 1 call for the password-less `email` link;
- then `CALLER_KEYS` (2) × `EMAIL_KEYS` (3) × `PRESENTED_KEYS` (3) = 18, minus the served row for each caller (an allowlisted email with the correct password), so 16 calls on the `email + password` link. That is 18 calls in all.

Each call goes through the production entry (`handleShareLinksRequest` on this mount) over `ObjectQL` on `@objectstack/driver-sql` with better-sqlite3, and a refused resolve probes the row to name the refusal. Its two siblings at `:334` and `:346` run the same kind of loop. The `beforeAll` has a 60 s budget, but every `it` runs under the 5000 ms default.

This is the stall shape #19828 describes: a process stall fails whichever test happened to be clocked.

Not measured: the case's duration on an idle runner. The red job's log reaches the API cut off at its last 5000 lines, so the file's per-test timing line is not in it. The `test-core-timings-6-of-6` artifact of run `39298888283` carries it.

## Proposed fix (not applied)

Give the loop cases in this file an explicit timeout sized to their measured work, as the precedents did:
- #22426 (for #22418, a `plugin-sharing` share-link case at the same default);
- #21920 (`rest`);
- #22356 (`lint`).

Alternatively, cut the work per case.

⛔ Do not skip or quarantine the case.

## Dedupe

I ran a semantic issue search on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` for `share-links-refusal-order test timed out flaky`. It returned 10 hits, all closed and all about other files:
- #22418 (`plugin-sharing` `share-link-password-webcontainer.test.ts`);
- #20242 (`client`);
- #21428 (`rest`);
- #20376 and #19631 (`plugin-dev`);
- #15852 (`plugin-auth`);
- #19828 (the class finding);
- #24024, #21405 and #23328 (share-link behaviour, not timing).

None names this file.
